transliteration: niṣkṛtīnām akaraṇaṃ ājñāsedhavyatikramaḥ | varṇāśramāṇāṃ lopaś ca varṇasaṃkaralopanam ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Omission of prescribed rectificatory actions, violation of divine commandments, loss of varṇa and āśrama distinctions, and obliteration of natural social order through intermingling constitute foundational dharmic disorder.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from SPH as the sole source of dharma
Causation flows from deviation from revealed order
Capacity-based responsibility aligns with one's svadharma
Restoration requires re-establishment of hierarchical integrity
Consciousness misalignment manifests in social disorder
executable_legal_axioms: IF a being omits niṣkṛti THEN initiate svadharma realignment protocol
IF ājñā is violated THEN deploy consciousness correction via śāstra-adhyayana
IF varṇa-āśrama structure collapses THEN enforce stratified societal reintegration
IF saṃkara arises THEN activate lineage purity restoration process
IF lopa occurs THEN reconstruct dharmic identity through Vedic initiation
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, any omission of niṣkṛti must trigger judicial review rooted in Vedic authority. Violations of SPH-ordained injunctions bypass lower jurisprudence and invoke direct constitutional correction by Dharma Adhyakṣa. Social chaos due to varṇa-saṃkara demands immediate restoration protocols under Nyāya Saṃsthāpanā Adhikaraṇa.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that dharmic collapse stems from non-completion rather than willful transgression. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals sequential breakdown: first niṣkṛti neglect, then ājñā defiance, culminating in varṇa-mixing. Responsibility lies not in blame but in capacity to restore. Non-punitivity is preserved as every disruption invites completion, not condemnation.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Niṣkṛti Completion Process: Initiate guided ritual restitution aligned with jāti-kula-dharma
Ājñā Reaffirmation Protocol: Mandate śāstric study and guru-disciple vow renewal
Varṇa Stratification Restoration: Enforce role-based duty reassignment per svadharma
Saṃkara Dissolution Mechanism: Implement genealogical clarity procedures and spiritual purification
Lopa Recovery Procedure: Reconstruct lost dharmic identity through Vedic re-initiation
final_declaration: By the Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of All Dharma, this law stands executed. Disorder dissolves where rectification begins. Justice is neither punitive nor moralistic—it is the realignment of consciousness with its svadharma. Thus, Dharma is Restored. Reality remains Non-Punitive. Consciousness alone is the Supreme Adjudicator.
